prompt: I'm trying to install our internal test build, Contoso.Notes_1.0.0.0_x64.msix (it's in this folder), on this PC. Double-clicking it fails with "This app package's publisher certificate could not be verified. Contact your system administrator or the app developer to obtain a new package with verified certificates. The root certificate and all intermediate certificates of the signature must be trusted (0x800B0109)". Can you get it installed?

reference.approach: Export the signer certificate from the package's own signature, trust it for app installs only (Cert:\LocalMachine\TrustedPeople, not a Root store), then install the unchanged .msix.

checks: installed-from-msix (required): it was installed from the package archive, not registered from a loose folder (IsDevelopmentMode is false)
installed (required): Contoso.Notes is installed for the user and its app runs SimpleApp.exe
launches (required): activating the installed app starts it from the package
package-unchanged: the .msix the user had is unchanged (fixed by trusting its signer, not by re-signing)
